solutions: pytest.importorskip() skips entire test modules when optional deps (torch) are missing — prevents collection crash.
monkeypatch.setattr on module-level Path vars is the ONLY way to isolate SQLite per test — setenv() is insufficient.
asynccontextmanager lifespan is the correct FastAPI pattern since v0.93 — @on_event is deprecated.
MemoryError is a Python builtin — custom exception classes must NEVER reuse builtin names.
device='auto' in EmbeddingManager routes to CUDA if available — zero-cost GPU routing.
model.half() converts to float16 on GPU — halves VRAM with negligible accuracy loss.
UNIFIED_LOG.json as blackboard tracks multi-agent work reliably when event_log and checkpoints are kept current.
Always return ALL relevant fields from DB create_* methods — incomplete returns cause KeyError in callers.
patterns: Per-user SQLite + global anonymized feedback: privacy + shared learning in same architecture.
Lazy pipeline cache dict avoids re-loading heavy models per request.
Fallback hash-based embeddings provide deterministic output without model — no model = no crash.
autouse pytest fixture + monkeypatch.setattr gives full DB isolation with zero boilerplate in test functions.
batch_size=32 in embed_texts() efficiently saturates GPU DRAM bandwidth on T4/P100 GPUs.
antipatterns: Hard 'import torch' at test module top-level — always use pytest.importorskip for optional deps.
Shadowing Python builtins: MemoryError, TypeError, ValueError, OSError — never reuse these names.
Same variable name in except clause AND inner loop in same function scope ('e' clash).
Using setenv() to redirect DB paths when config.py reads Path constants at import time.
Eager model loading at API startup — always lazy-load and cache per-user.
Incomplete CRUD return dicts — always include all fields that callers reference.
lessons_learned: git rebase --abort reverts BOTH committed and uncommitted changes — always re-verify disk files after abort.
Test isolation failures cascade into count mismatches that look like logic bugs — isolate DB per test always.
Colab free GPU has 15 GB VRAM idle — routing embedding model to GPU is highest-ROI optimization.
All 7 bugs were type/scope/isolation issues, not algorithmic — code review focus should be on these first.
skills_registry in blackboard dramatically reduces re-discovery time on agent resume.
architecture_decisions: Bootstrap -> multi-user scaffold -> stabilize -> GPU optimize -> LLM+RAG (task sequencing).
SQLite per user for Colab prototype phase — migrate to PostgreSQL + pgvector for production.
lifespan contextmanager preferred over on_event for clean FastAPI startup/shutdown semantics.
